heading: Instant Messaging Apps Built for Real-time

paragraphs.html: Messaging apps live and die on speed and reliability. Messages must arrive instantly, in order, on any connection.
We build on proven real-time infrastructure with push notifications, media sharing, read receipts, end-to-end security options and call features.
Start your instant messaging app development project with an experienced team. Tell us about your idea and we will help you take it from concept to launch and beyond.
